label: CAS-based optimistic locking (Java/Python SDK)
type: the compare-and-swap concurrency control mechanism where a document's CAS value, read alongside its content, is passed back on a subsequent write so the server can detect and reject a write based on stale data - the SDK's default, always-on concurrency model, contrasted with the opt-in sdk:pessimistic-locking (getAndLock)
